title: Eathon the dog
summary: Eathon is the Professor's dog, whom he named after Eathon Lambert. Though initially suspected that the dog might be the Seeker, Eathon Lambert, who had been converted into a dog by the professor's magic, this information is later shown to be incorrect. After the Professor's defeat, Hoffman took custody of the dog.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
During the Professor's attempt to summon Overlos, the Titan of Immortality, Eathon was left to summon his two Undergolem Titans in order to keep the Huntik team occupied. After finally defeating the Titans, Dante called him by name to stop him from warning the Professor. [The Mission]

Eathon led Hoffman to the Chu-Goku mount where he found the hidden Amulet of Divine Mirror Kagami. [Knight of the Willblade]

When Grier helped the Huntik team to access the castle in order to find the Professor's files on Rassimov, Eathon the dog summoned his two Undergolem Titans again to stop them. [An Ally from the Organization]

sections.heading: Personality
sections.wikitext: Using the powers of [[Araknos]], the Legendary Titan of Mind, [[the Professor]] rewrote the mind of his dog, giving him the ability to invoke Titans and making the dog be extremely loyal him. Despite the fact that Araknos and the Professor are no longer around, Eathon the dog retains his ability to summon his Undergolem Titans as a triggered response to the castle being threatened. {{source|An Ally from the Organization}}
sections.text: Using the powers of Araknos, the Legendary Titan of Mind, the Professor rewrote the mind of his dog, giving him the ability to invoke Titans and making the dog be extremely loyal him. [An Ally from the Organization]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext: As the Professor rewrote the very framework of this dog's mind with Araknos, Eathon does not have to worry about whether his bark is worse than his bite. He is bonded to two [[Undergolem]] Titans and has the ability to find hidden amulets such as that of [[Divine Mirror Kagami]]. {{Source|Knight of the Willblade}}

full_text:
Eathon is the Professor's dog, whom he named after Eathon Lambert. Though initially suspected that the dog might be the Seeker, Eathon Lambert, who had been converted into a dog by the professor's magic, this information is later shown to be incorrect. After the Professor's defeat, Hoffman took custody of the dog.

== History ==
During the Professor's attempt to summon Overlos, the Titan of Immortality, Eathon was left to summon his two Undergolem Titans in order to keep the Huntik team occupied. After finally defeating the Titans, Dante called him by name to stop him from warning the Professor. [The Mission]

Eathon led Hoffman to the Chu-Goku mount where he found the hidden Amulet of Divine Mirror Kagami. [Knight of the Willblade]

When Grier helped the Huntik team to access the castle in order to find the Professor's files on Rassimov, Eathon the dog summoned his two Undergolem Titans again to stop them. [An Ally from the Organization] 

==Personality==
Using the powers of Araknos, the Legendary Titan of Mind, the Professor rewrote the mind of his dog, giving him the ability to invoke Titans and making the dog be extremely loyal him. Despite the fact that Araknos and the Professor are no longer around, Eathon the dog retains his ability to summon his Undergolem Titans as a triggered response to the castle being threatened. [An Ally from the Organization]

==Abilities==
As the Professor rewrote the very framework of this dog's mind with Araknos, Eathon does not have to worry about whether his bark is worse than his bite. He is bonded to two Undergolem Titans and has the ability to find hidden amulets such as that of Divine Mirror Kagami. [Knight of the Willblade]
